resources.string: Debug test build for sensory comfort. Reads accessibility labels locally to mute recognized ads and optionally show a dark, still cover in YouTube, Tubi, and Plex. An explicit developer command can take one diagnostic screenshot; pixels are discarded and only brightness counts are retained. No continuous capture, OCR, uploads, or recordings. Press Back twice to release protection for one minute. Detection can miss ads and cannot guarantee protection from flashes.
